thread:
Sana (People Ops): Quick ask 14CB trying to make a one page manager cheat for OKR check-ins. Need tiny, copyable text for templates. Thoughts?
Miguel M: Love it. Include a line to map work -> objective impact so ICs can write intent fast.
Priya K: Add a one-line feedback rubric: Evidence / Impact / Next step. Keeps 1:1s actionable.
Ben R: I have a compact template I used in 20m check-ins: 
```
Goal: one-liner + metric
Why: 1 sentence
This sprint: 2 actions (owners + dates)
Ask: what I need from you
Confidence: 1-5
```
Liu Z: Add cross-team dependency row (owner + ETA).
Sana (People Ops): Draft for review below, please react with :+1: or suggest edits.
Sana (People Ops): ```
MANAGER PRE-CHECK (60s): alignment | metric | blockers
IC: "Ship X to improve Y by Z% (metric)"
Why: 1-line customer/business impact
Sprint commits: 2 concrete actions (owner, date)
Confidence: 1-5 | Blockers: short list + owner
Ask from manager: specific support
Feedback rubric: Evidence -> Impact -> Next step (script: "When you did X I saw Y. That caused Z. Try A next time.")
Calibration note (copy): Outcome: short; Signals: 2 bullets; Leveling note: 1 sentence
Use per-OKR, keep to 6 lines to keep convo tight.
```
Priya K: This is great - I'll pilot with my team next week.
Miguel M: Suggest adding a sample stretch-goal phrasing.
Sana (People Ops): Will add and post in the performance kickoff. Ping me if you want a mock 1:1.
CoachBot: Tip: pre-fill template before the 1:1 to make the meeting productive.
